worlds.title: The Hundred-Year Silence
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.description: For a hundred years the Rite of Giving was performed and nothing came. This year it worked — and the Church is owed a debt for every year it waited.

worlds.title: The Girl Everyone Fears
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.genre: College drama — social hierarchy, rivalry, romance
worlds.description: You run this campus. Then your mother introduces a fiancé and his son, and for the first time in years someone looks at you like you are not frightening at all.

worlds.title: The Village of Women
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.genre: Japanese village romance — slice of life, comedy
worlds.description: Once every ten years the deity guides one man to Onna no Sato. You are him, the lanterns are lit, and every woman in the valley has an opinion about it.

worlds.title: Lumencia Academy
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.description: An imperial academy where the blade and the arcane are tested against each other — and something older moves beneath the empire.

worlds.title: The Hood Falls
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.description: A child's face unveiled, destiny unravels amid fire and fear.

worlds.title: Dying for the Crown
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.description: Saved the kingdom once as a saint; now forced to survive it as its worst villain.

worlds.title: The Emberwake
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.description: The mountain has been burning for forty years. Last night it started walking — and it is heading for the last city that still has water.
